name: Ingrid Halvorsen

kit.name: Cold (heat theft)
kit.description: Not ice blasts — heat theft. The most Minnesotan power in the game: the cold isn't hers, it's everyone else's, held.

moves.name: Draw
moves.description: Siphons heat from an enemy: they slow, she gains armor frost.

moves.name: Black Ice
moves.description: Paints a ground patch — enemies slide, her squad skates: allies crossing it get a free dash.

moves.name: Shelter
moves.description: A snow-squall dome that blocks projectiles both ways — the "okay everybody breathe" button.

signature.name: January
signature.description: Drops the local temperature to lethal-cold for six seconds; everything hostile freezes mid-pose like a photograph of a blizzard. Control, not clear — the squad chooses which statues matter. Conversations still end.

personality.summary: Economical with words, extravagant with actions; competitive only where nobody can see; the person everyone assumes is fine, and never is.

romance.notes: Oriented (women) — not into you, and that's content: her arc, including the protected Ingrid–Petra geometry, runs at full richness on the friendship/ally track.

recruitHook: The arena's rink chiller dies mid-heatwave and she's been keeping the ice frozen herself, secretly, eighteen hours a day, and it's killing her. Notice. Fix the chiller or get the money for it. She joins because you saw her working — she'll never say that's why.
differentiation: BINDING (docs/04 §1.4): January deals NO damage, and each freeze BREAKS ON HIT — control, not clear.
Shelter blocks projectiles BOTH ways — the squad's only breathe button.
